ownership_decision.invariant: Run decides whether a run may reach a sandbox, reading the skill's restriction through its registry port at creation and again at dispatch.

boundary_decision.interaction: Unchanged: run reads skill facts through its existing registry port.

domain_forces: A restriction set while a run waited in the queue did not stop it: dispatch read only the version, minted the package grant and handed the package to a sandbox.
implementation_design.decision: Dispatch re-reads the skill's restriction before placement; a restricted skill ends the run as policy_refused with the license-review wording, and an unreadable restriction keeps the run queued.
invariants_preserved: The restriction is never read as lifted because a read failed.
A version that is gone still fails through the existing unbuildable path.
rejected_alternatives: Cancelling queued runs when the restriction is set: it needs a consumer for the restriction event, and a run admitted in the same instant would still slip through; the dispatch check covers both.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: Making requireStillRunnable ignore the restriction fails TestARestrictionSetWhileARunWaitsStopsItBeforeAnySandbox with the run succeeded.

record.statement: A run of a skill under an access restriction is refused when it is created, and a run that was queued before the restriction was set fails as policy_refused at dispatch, before any sandbox receives the package; while the restriction cannot be read the run stays queued.
examples: A run queued before an operator sets license-review fails as policy_refused naming the license review, and the sandbox sees no dispatch; after the restriction is cleared a new run succeeds.

approvals.scope: A licensing hold set while a run is queued stops it at dispatch; new run-context rule
